title: Aftermarket Cloud India — 0-to-1 GTM Build
description: Built the full GTM motion from scratch for a new SaaS product entering the Indian market. Developed the ICP and account segmentation across 75+ targets, generated ~$4M in qualified pipeline, and activated 20+ SI relationships producing ~$2.5M in net-new partner pipeline. Established positioning, outreach playbooks, and SI onboarding frameworks.

caseStudy.context: A global vendor's aftermarket SaaS product had no India motion — no ICP, no pipeline, no partner coverage.
caseStudy.decision: Enter through a focused 0-to-1 build rather than a broad launch: define the ICP first, then sequence accounts by propensity.
caseStudy.move: Segmented 75+ target accounts on fit and intent signals, with an outreach playbook per segment instead of a single script.
caseStudy.model: Direct outreach and SI partnerships run as one motion — 20+ integrator relationships activated to multiply coverage.
caseStudy.outcome: ~$4M qualified pipeline in the product's first India year, ~$2.5M of it net-new through partners.

title: VoltMX Product Strategy — Growth Markets
description: Led product strategy and requirements definition for the VoltMX low-code platform across growth markets. Authored 55+ structured feature definitions, mapped 10+ distinct buyer personas, and developed 15+ sector-specific use cases spanning BFSI, healthcare, and the India public sector.

caseStudy.context: A low-code platform entering growth markets, with feature demands arriving faster than strategy could vet them.
caseStudy.decision: Anchor the roadmap in buyer personas and sector use cases — not in the loudest deal in the room.
caseStudy.move: Authored 55+ structured feature definitions mapped to 10+ personas and 15+ sector use cases across BFSI, healthcare and public sector.
caseStudy.model: One definition pipeline from field signal → persona fit → structured spec, keeping product and GTM in a single loop.
caseStudy.outcome: A defensible growth-market roadmap: every shipped definition traceable to a named persona and a sector case.

title: India Public Sector — Sales Strategy, Year 1
description: Stood up the sales strategy function for the India public sector vertical — the founding year of the practice. Built a $8M pipeline across 60+ accounts and closed >$1.5M in ACV. Developed account intelligence frameworks, competitive battle cards, and the full sector engagement playbook.

caseStudy.context: The public sector vertical was founded with no playbook: no account intelligence, no competitive assets, no strategy function.
caseStudy.decision: Stand strategy up as a founding function — build the intelligence layer before chasing the quarter.
caseStudy.move: Account intelligence frameworks and competitive battle cards across 60+ accounts; the full sector engagement playbook codified.
caseStudy.model: Long-cycle government pursuit discipline paired with quarterly pipeline reviews the sales team actually used.
caseStudy.outcome: $8M pipeline and >$1.5M closed ACV in year one — the function's founding year.

description: Competed in the National Consulting Olympiad out of IIM Indore. Ranked 4th nationally across 300+ teams through multiple elimination rounds solving business strategy cases under strict time constraints.
